articles.title: From Whale 'Hellos' to Chatty Cats: The Race to Decode Animal Language
articles.summary: Advances in AI and bioacoustics are bringing us closer to two-way communication with animals. A 2023 humpback whale 'conversation' and genetic tweaks in mice hint that a real-life Dug collar may not be far off.

articles.title: 50 Years After Viking 1, NASA's Next Mars Move Is Taking to the Skies
articles.summary: On the 50th anniversary of the first U.S. Mars landing, NASA is preparing the Skyfall mission to deploy three helicopters in 2028. Meanwhile, the search for life continues with Perseverance's sample collection.

articles.title: Young Sauropods Could Rear Up Like Giants, But Gravity Caught Up With Age
articles.summary: Using engineering simulations, scientists found that two South American sauropods—Uberabatitan and Neuquensaurus—could stand on their hind legs, but only juveniles did so comfortably. Adults faced extreme bone stress.
